tools.name: get_markets
tools.description: All 36 OUROS markets on Hyperliquid (crypto, stocks, commodities, FX, index): price, 24h change, hourly funding, 24h volume, max leverage.

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Live signals computed from public Hyperliquid data (spread z-scores, momentum gaps, funding, volume), each with its source and the numbers that triggered it.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: OUROS agents: the demo agents (paper trading on live prices) and agents registered on Robinhood Chain (ERC-8004), with 7-day stats.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One agent with its strategy, limits and stats. Use a demo ID (e.g. atlas-01) or an ERC-8004 agent ID (a number).

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.description: Recent decision receipts of a demo agent, each with its SHA-256 hash and UTC day. Verify any of them with verify_receipt.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Re-hash a receipt (canonical JSON, SHA-256), fold its Merkle proof and compare with the published daily root. Pass the receipt object or its hash.

tools.name: simulate_strategy
tools.description: Paper-backtest a pair strategy on the last 7 days of Hyperliquid prices with $10,000, the same engine the OUROS launch desk uses.

tools.name: get_model_prices
tools.description: The models an OUROS agent can think with, with live OpenRouter prices per 1M tokens and context length.
